Gumroad hackathon

$100K Niche Marketplace Hackathon

Build a specialized marketplace using Gumroad's MIT-licensed code that serves creators in a specific niche. Help creators find their perfect audience and customers discover their ideal creators.

Official terms & details

Why we're doing this

We're opening up our codebase to help creators reach more customers
and build innovative niche marketplaces.

Open source

Why not? If there's not a good reason to keep the source code a secret, we want to give it to the world.

Small team

We're a small team, and if the code is open-source, it means more people can help us ship things for creators.

MIT licensed

Now that we're MIT licensed, we want to give everyone a proper chance to build with our code.

Ideas and inspiration

Get creative

The sky's the limit when it comes to potential marketplaces
you could build. Here are some ideas to get you started.

Audio marketplace

A marketplace exclusively for audio professionals selling ambient soundscapes, field recordings, and sound effects for film, gaming, and meditation apps.

Digital patterns

For digital pattern creators across knitting, sewing, crochet, embroidery, and quilting.

Mentorship platform

A marketplace where experienced creators offer mentorship sessions, portfolio reviews, and career guidance to emerging talent.

Publishing services

Services marketplace connecting indie authors with book cover designers, editors, formatters, and marketing specialists.

Culinary platform

Platform for chefs and food specialists to sell cooking courses, recipe collections, and technique-focused tutorials.

Timeline

Important dates

Mark your calendar for these key milestones in the
Gumroad $100K Niche Marketplace Hackathon.

Submissions open

Now through Sept 15, 2025

Submission deadline

Sept 15, 2025 at 11:59 PM ET. Submit your project here.

Finalists announced

Oct 2025

Finalist celebration

In New York: Winter 2025

Prize structure

$100,000 in prizes

We're offering substantial rewards for the best
niche marketplaces built during this hackathon.

Grand prize

$100,000 for the most impactful niche marketplace

Additional prizes

We'll also be giving prizes to:

  • Highest GMV - $5,000
  • Most creative/unique - $2,500
  • $1,000 each to ten novel projects

Questions?

How winners are determined

We're using a multi-factor scoring approach focusing on real marketplace health:

1. 50% Quality
   a. Well-defined creator niche
   b. Niche needs a solution (aka minimal alternatives)
   c. How well your solution addresses their needs

2. 50% Quantity
   a. Average earnings per creator
   b. Creator retention rate after 30 days
   c. Buyer-to-creator ratio (healthy marketplace balance)
   d. Month-over-month growth in both creators and buyers
   e. Sustainable customer acquisition strategy

Eligibility

Open to anyone, anywhere in the world
Individual and team submissions welcome
No coding experience? Team up with developers
Gumroad employees and immediate family not eligible

Submission requirements

Working niche marketplace built on Gumroad's MIT-licensed code

Documentation of your niche strategy and target creator community, including:
• One-paragraph description of your specific marketplace focus
• Target creator types and the products/services they'll sell
• How your marketplace differs from existing platforms

Verifiable creator and buyer metrics
3-minute video showcasing your marketplace in action
Submission form completed by Sept 15, 2025, at 11:59 PM ET

Presentations

10-15 projects will be selected as finalists and notified via email.
Finalists and presentations will be announced in the early fall (specific dates to come).
